status: FORWARD TEST of a strategy that FAILED its backtest promotion gate (DD 14.8% > 12%, DSR 0.90 < 0.95) — paper only, not a promotion
parent_result: docs/research/STRATEGY_LAB_RESULTS_2026-10.md — crisis-core-v1 FAIL (C1 max DD 14.77% > 12%; C3 DSR 0.90 < 0.95). Not tuned, not re-run.
account: Alpaca PAPER account of portfolio_3 (Cautious Sniper). PAPER ONLY — the engine refuses any non-paper base_url.
objective: Measure live PAPER tracking of the scaled crisis_core_v1 weights against the same weights simulated on daily closes (execution fidelity, cost, cap discipline, operational integrity). This is NOT evidence of edge and cannot promote the strategy.
universe: Equity SPY QQQ IWM EFA; managed futures DBMF KMLM CTA; IEF; T-bill basket BIL SHV SGOV USFR (priority order). Legacy P3 symbols are never traded by this sleeve.

scaling.reason: P3 hard per-symbol cap max_position_pct_per_symbol = 8% (event-driven-bot/config/risk_limits.json, NOT modified). The tested 11.4%/ETF weights would breach it.
scaling.applies_to: every spec weight (8 risky ETFs 11.4% -> 7.6%; T-bill basket 8.8% -> 5.8667%, each basket member <= 7.6%), the no-trade band (2% -> 1.3333% of equity, absolute) and the drift guard (12% -> 8%). Residual (33.33%) = uninvested cash.
scaling.capital_basis: Weights are fractions of TOTAL P3 equity. Legacy positions count toward equity but are never traded; if legacy + sleeve would exceed P3 max_gross_exposure_pct (80%) or available cash, sleeve BUYS are scaled down pro rata (legacy is never sold).

params.snapshot: latest completed daily close before the session (the prior month-end close on the first session of a month; the latest close on a catch-up / first-enablement run)
params.execution: first p3-trading session of the month (~09:50 ET), marketable DAY limits
params.targets_frozen: per calendar month; a month is complete only when every order for it filled fully, nothing was deferred by the trade budget and no buy was clipped by a P3 limit — until then each session retries the diff against the SAME frozen targets

entry_rule: Monthly rebalance to the frozen scaled targets with an absolute 1.3333% band; |target - current| < band => no trade, except target == 0 with holdings (sell to zero) and total symbol weight > 7.6% (trade to target). First run after enablement builds the full target at once.
exit_rule: No discretionary exits and no stops (static weights). Band, drift guard (any sleeve symbol whose total weight > 8% at a session is trimmed to target, every session) and cap rules only. P3's daily-loss kill switch still liquidates the whole book.
sizing: qty = floor(min(target_w - current_w, 7.6% - total_w) x equity / max(last, limit)); whole shares only; skip < 1 share, < $250 order notional, or a NEW position < P3 min_position_notional_usd ($2,000). Post-trade total position <= 7.6% (and therefore < 8%) of equity at max(live price, limit price).

execution.orders: marketable DAY LIMIT: buys ask x 1.0025, sells bid x 0.9975 (crossed/missing/>1% wide quote => last trade). Never market orders.
execution.client_order_id: shared.alpaca_http.make_client_order_id('p3alloc', symbol, side, <ET session date>) — at most one order per symbol/side/session; a 422 is a duplicate only if that id exists at the broker.
execution.fills: booked only from the broker's terminal order state (confirm_fill / get_order): real filled_qty x filled_avg_price; a non-terminal order is a pending record booked at the next run or the EOD journal. Never a limit or quote price.
execution.order_budget: P3 max_trades_per_day (15), shared with every other P3 order that session; sells/trims first, then buys by |delta w| descending; the rest waits for the next session.
execution.guards: python-level market-open check (plus the workflow gate); P3 halt or daily loss at/over the kill switch => no buys (trims allowed); failed preflight or unusable risk limits => no orders; incomplete/stale snapshot => no orders (a data gap is never read as 'unlisted').

signal_bar: close of the last completed session before the rebalance session

fill.bar: the live session after the signal close (intraday, ~09:50 ET)

friction_note: fees_bps/slippage_bps are the repo-floor friction applied to the SIMULATED comparator only; the live sleeve pays whatever it actually pays and is measured (criterion F4).
benchmark: Tracking reference: the same frozen scaled targets simulated on actual daily closes over the forward window (same band/drift rules, next-session execution at the session's close as a proxy for the 09:50 ET fill, repo-floor friction). SPY buy-and-hold reported for information only.

evaluation.clock: trading days since the first allocator fill (day 1 = first session with a filled p3alloc order)
evaluation.data: event-driven-bot/data/trade_log.json (tranche allocator_forward_test), event-driven-bot/data/allocator_state.json, broker FILL activities and order history for client_order_id prefix p3alloc, Supabase portfolio_equity_history (portfolio_3), market_daily_history closes.

metrics.sleeve_return: r_t = (sum over allocator lots of realized + unrealized P&L change on session t) / P3 equity at close t-1 — the same basis as the simulated weights (fractions of total equity).
metrics.simulated_return: s_t = sum_i w_i,t-1 x close-to-close return_i,t of the simulated scaled book (weights drift between rebalances), minus simulated friction on rebalance days.
metrics.tracking_error: stdev(r_t - s_t) x sqrt(252), annualized, over all sessions since day 1.
metrics.max_drawdown: max drawdown of I_t = prod(1 + r_t) (sleeve index on the total-equity basis).
metrics.slippage: per fill, adverse-positive bps vs the decision reference price (last trade at decision): buy (fill - ref)/ref x 1e4, sell (ref - fill)/ref x 1e4; notional-weighted mean across all allocator fills.
metrics.cap_breach: any allocator order whose post-trade TOTAL symbol position at max(live price, limit price) exceeds 8% of equity at submission, OR any symbol above 8% of equity at a session close that is not trimmed at the next session.
metrics.duplicate_orders: more than one broker order per (p3alloc, symbol, side, session), more than one trade-log buy row per broker order id, or any fill booked twice.

acceptance.scope: Evaluated at 60 and 90 trading days. ALL must hold at each checkpoint.

F1_tracking_error.benchmark: the CAP-CONSTRAINED target the engine computed each session (recorded in allocator_state.json), simulated on daily closes — NOT the unconstrained scaled weights. Underweight caused by P3's 80% gross cap or cash while legacy positions run off is cap COMPLIANCE, reported separately as 'cap_shortfall_pct' (informational), never counted as tracking error.

acceptance.stop_rules: F3 or F5 failing at ANY time => the human owner disables the allocator block immediately (does not wait for a checkpoint). F2 breached intraperiod => committee review within 1 session.
acceptance.outcome: PASS at 90 days => recorded as forward EXECUTION evidence only; the strategy stays a FAILED backtest candidate and stays paper. Any promotion requires a NEW pre-registered spec that passes the full backtest gate + committee. FAIL => disable via strategy_controls (human), record, do not tune.

governance.enablement: config/strategy_controls.json portfolio_3.allocator = {strategy: crisis_core_v1, mode: paper_forward_test, enabled: true, scale_to_cap: true, reason, changed_at, changed_by}. Human-owned; code never writes it; missing/malformed => disabled.
governance.risk_limits: config/risk_limits.json and event-driven-bot/config/risk_limits.json are read-only inputs and are NOT modified.
governance.legacy: P3 legacy event-driven entries remain quarantined (new_entries_enabled=false); its open lots run off under their brackets and are never traded by this sleeve.

known_limitations: Forward window (60-90 sessions) is far too short to say anything about return or edge; the criteria are execution/fidelity criteria by design.
Latest-quote/last-trade prices are IEX on the free data tier.
Cap/gross-room clipping while legacy runs off is reported as cap_shortfall_pct and is NOT counted in F1 (see amendments, 2026-10-23).
pre_registration_note: Written before the allocator placed any order. Edits after the first allocator fill void the checkpoints; amendments must be appended with date + reason.

amendments.change: F1 benchmark defined as the cap-constrained engine target; cap shortfall reported separately.
amendments.why: At enablement legacy positions (~32% of equity) + the sleeve exceed P3's 80% gross cap, so the sleeve deploys ~73% of target until legacy runs off. That is a hard-limit constraint, not strategy tracking error.

amendments.effective_from: the 2026-11 monthly freeze (the frozen 2026-10 targets and the live book are NOT changed mid-month; no sells are triggered by this amendment — the band decides any trade at the 2026-11 freeze)
amendments.change: T-bill residual restored: after the scaled risky weights (8 x 7.6%) and the scaled basket share (5.8667%), the remaining residual is allocated to the T-bill basket in priority order BIL, SHV, SGOV, USFR, each member's total weight <= live_cap 7.6%, bounded by P3's remaining gross-exposure room at the freeze (max_gross 80% incl. legacy positions — T-bill ETFs count toward gross — less a 1pp headroom so price drift does not leave the month permanently clipped). Only what is left after that stays cash. With no legacy: residual 12.33% (BIL +1.73pp to 7.6%, SHV 7.6%, SGOV 3.0%), total 79%. With today's ~32% legacy: residual 0 (unchanged book). Recorded per freeze in allocator_state.json as targets_core, targets and residual_tbill {budget, added, legacy_gross_w_at_freeze, cash_residual}.
amendments.why: Audit-found deviation from the PARENT spec's residual rule (docs/specs/crisis_core_v1.json: residual -> T-bill basket; 'basket overflow -> cash' only after the basket is full). The cap scaling dropped that rule, leaving ~33% of P3 in 0% cash (~1%/yr drag). This restores the parent rule within P3's hard limits; it is NOT a tuning and changes no risky weight, band, cap or execution rule.
